name: Stellar Plajig
desc: An enhanced version of a Plajig. The lightning dancing along the halberd crackles in anticipation, landing powerful bolt-like attacks on targets.

eff.name: Thunder Spear
eff.desc1: Deals [50 + (Lv. x 10)] power bolt damage. Damage is increased by [Lv. x 3]% when environmental mana gauge is at 50% or higher.
eff.desc2: Deals [50 + (Lv. x 10)] power bolt damage and grants a [Lv. x 5]% chance to Daze the target.

eff.name: High-Voltage Current
eff.desc1: Increases acquirable environmental mana by [Lv. x 1]% if the target is inflicted with Paralysis.
eff.desc2: Grants a [Lv. x 10]% chance to inflict 1 stack(s) of Paralysis on the target.

eff.name: Dazzling Dwarf Star
eff.desc1: Reduces target's critical rate by [Lv. x 30]%.
eff.desc2: Lowers target's bolt resistance by [Lv. x 1] stage(s).
